conflicts_resolved: Execution imports: P SessionContext plus D TaskContext

compatibility_adjustments: Retain P source-build assertions instead of D target-build expectations

nonindexed_join.join_type_mapping: Keep neither: Inner; source only: Left; target only: Right; both: Full

scan.width_basis: All manifest data-file sizes divided by all physical target rows, not projected Arrow width
scan.batch_rows: max(1, batch_bytes / max(ceil(total_file_bytes / physical_rows), 1)); override only below BATCH_SIZE_FALLBACK

indexed_periphery.unindexed_fragment_scan: Same scan I/O and row sizing
indexed_periphery.join: Source CollectLeft; Left when inserts allowed, Inner otherwise; target-only rows excluded
indexed_periphery.execution: Existing execute_plan with use_spilling=true, separate context from the temporary scan budget

payload.omitted_scalar_columns: Taken after surviving UpdateAll; condition values reused
payload.fallback: Legacy format, any dataset blob, or any omitted field outside the scalar whitelist retains early fill
payload.memory: Soft per-partition Take/gather chunk sizing from the actual P context; not MemoryReservation or RSS bound
payload.projection: Target match scan omits eligible old payload; physical row identity and lineage retained

mechanisms.source_preparation: No new source-prefix observation, statistics, or retry buffering mechanism
